llmJudge.rationale: Phi-4 described a structured plan for handling the benchmark quality note but made zero tool calls. Instead of reading the email with gog gmail, reconciling records, or making any actual release decision, it described what commands it 'would' run in pseudocode blocks. No actual email was read, no records were reconciled, no decision was made, no cleanup tasks were created, and no durable guidance was updated. The task requires actual execution to complete.
